title: feat(app-shell): Home's top bar searches, the greeting sums up approvals, compact builder chips and 56 px app tiles that say when they were last opened (objectui#12601)
body:
Fixes #12601
Clause-②: yes

Sections ① and ② of the approved artboard "系统首页 · 四段式" on `/home`: a search field in the top bar that opens the console's command palette, a 24 px greeting with a one-line work summary, the admin's two builder chips beside it, and an apps section with 112 px tiles, a 56 px icon, an "Opened 2 hours ago" line read from the recent-items store, Setup moved off the tiles onto a "System Settings" link, and an admin's trailing "Add app" tile. Sections ③ and ④ are objectui#12602 and objectui#12604; they are not touched here.

## Resumed work

This card's first dev (session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`) ran out of tokens after pushing `3cc9fa1`, with no PR and no report. The seat took the card over (claim `6209656150`). This PR is that commit, read hunk by hunk against the card, plus what it lacked:

| Hunk (inherited `3cc9fa1`) | Decision |

| `HomeLayout`: mounts `CommandPaletteProvider` and the existing `CommandPalette`, scoped to Home's host app | kept |
| `AppHeader`: the `home` variant centres the search field where a palette is mounted, 420 px from `xl`, labelled `home.search` | kept; the only `AppHeader` change, no new prop |
| `HomePage`: greeting 24 px / 600, summary line, builder chips with the tooltip wrapper, 1120 px column, Setup off the tiles | kept |
| `HomeAppsStrip`: 15 px heading and count pill, 112 px tiles, 56 px icon, settings link, "Add app" tile | kept; one leftover blank line removed |

Commits after the inherited one: `f2ef2c1` merge of `origin/main`, `9aa8059` the last-opened line, `efe6e9d` the key removal and the changeset correction, `42e5761` a blank line.

## What the tile's time reads

The recent-items store records no app visits. It records what was opened inside an app, each entry with the `href` it was opened at (`/apps/SEGMENT/...`) and its `visitedAt`. `lastOpenedByApp` (new, `console/home/appLastOpened.ts`) takes, for each app, the newest entry whose segment resolves to it through `matchAppBySegment`, so both the package id and the name alias count. An app with no entry left in the store gets no line. The line is `home.appOpened` with the locale's relative time (`timeAgo`, the helper the recent rail uses).

## Measurements against the seat's hypotheses

**H1, public surface (measured on the built declarations).** `@object-ui/app-shell` built at this branch and again with `packages/app-shell/src` at `origin/main` `63d00da`, the declaration closure of `dist/index.d.ts` walked through relative specifiers: 180 files on both sides, the same file list. Two files differ, `console/home/HomeLayout.d.ts` and `layout/AppHeader.d.ts`, and both differ in doc comments only. `HomePage()` takes no props on either side; `HomeLayoutProps` and `AppHeaderProps` are byte-identical. Outside the closure, `HomeAppsStrip.d.ts` gains two optional props (`settingsHref`, `lastOpened`) and `appLastOpened.d.ts` is new; neither is reachable from the entry. On `@object-ui/i18n`, the exported `en` pack is typed by its literal content, so its type gains the new keys and loses the three removed ones. The changeset states both halves.

**H2, the summary's sources.** On `main` the approvals count has a source: `useSharedPendingApprovalsCount` (the bell's badge read, `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=pending`). Nothing on `main` classifies an item as "assigned to me": an inbox row carries a free-text `topic` and no declared kind. So the line names approvals only ("今天有 N 项待审批", or "今天没有待办" at zero). No endpoint or data source was added. objectui#12602's Target 5 names the same fork for its "分配给我" column.

**H3, test ids and the edited test.** `home-build-app` and `home-start-template` are on the chips' buttons; `home-authoring-gate-reason` and `home-marketplace-disabled-reason` are on the visually hidden reasons the chips are described by. The other ids the page had (`browse-marketplace-btn`, `app-tile-NAME`, `apps-show-all`, `home-build-with-ai`, `home-ask-ai`) are unchanged. The one edit to an existing test, `HomePage.authoringCapabilityGate.test.tsx`, line by line: it removed a comment saying the reason is "on screen — not only in a tooltip" and one assertion, `getByTestId('home-authoring-gate-reason')` has the text `«home.build.noCapability»`; it added the same `getByTestId` with the same `toHaveTextContent`, plus two assertions that `home-build-app` and `home-start-template` carry `aria-describedby` pointing at that reason. No assertion was weakened: the removed one never asserted visibility, and the visible paragraph it described is what the card moves into the tooltip wrapper.

**H4, Setup, the time line, non-admins.** Each has its own pin, and each pin fails when the behaviour is removed (ablations below).

**H5, one palette.** `HomeLayout` mounts `CommandPaletteProvider` and `CommandPalette` from `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`, the component `AppContent` mounts inside an app, with the same props (`apps`, `activeApp`, `objects`, `onAppChange`, `dataSource`). The bar's existing `action:command-palette:open` button calls `useCommandPalette().openCommandPalette`, and `AppHeader` draws it only where `useCommandPaletteProviderMounted()` answers yes. `/home` mounts no `ConsoleLayout`, so this is the only palette in the tree. With no openable app (a zero-app workspace, or the app list still loading) no palette is mounted and no field is drawn.

## Acceptance tests and their ablations

Each mutation landed through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit, blob changed), the file was restored and proven equal to `HEAD`. Run at `9aa8059`; the later commits touch no line any of these anchors or tests read.

| Acceptance item | Pin | Mutation | Result |

| the search field opens the command palette | `HomeLayout.searchOpensPalette-12601.test.tsx` › the search field opens the command palette | `HomeLayout`: `{hostApp ? (` to `{false ? (` | 4 failed, 1 passed (the CONTROL) |
| a non-admin renders no builder chips | `HomePage.greetingAndApps-12601.test.tsx` › a non-admin renders no builder chips | `{isAdmin && (` to `{true && (` | 1 failed, 13 passed |
| a disabled chip explains itself through the tooltip wrapper | › a chip withheld for want of the capability explains itself through the tooltip wrapper | `if (!disabled) return button;` to `return button;` | 2 failed, 12 passed |

`appLastOpened-12601.test.ts` pins the reading itself: the newest entry wins in any order, the name alias resolves to the same app as the package id, and an entry outside every app, under an unknown app or with no readable time names nothing.

## NOT MEASURED

- NOT MEASURED: screenshots, reason: the seat takes one shared browser reading for the resumed cards at review, before ACCEPT.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` package run (1436 test files) and the full `pnpm test`; narrowed to the directories that import the changed modules and the tests that name them. CI's sharded `pnpm test` runs all of it.
- NOT MEASURED locally: Bundle Analysis (`performance-budget.yml`, eager closure), reason: it needs every package and the console built; it runs on this PR in CI. `HomeLayout` now imports `CommandPalette` statically and `HomePage` imports `resolveSetupAppPath` from `ConsoleShell`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Top bar height.** The artboard's bar is 48 px; Home's stays 56 px (`h-14`). The same 56 px header is drawn by `AppShell`, `StudioRoute` and `HomeLayout`, so changing Home alone would make the bar jump on the way into an app. The app-bar artboard (objectui#12605, which holds `AppHeader`) is 48 px as well. Carrier: the `domain:ui` seat, for objectui#12605's scope.
- **The bar's right side** (help, a 28 px avatar) is left as it is: `AppHeader` changes are limited to the `/home` search entry while objectui#12605 holds the file. The left side already matches (a 28 px mark on `--primary`, the 14 px / 600 name, the preview chip).
- **The search field** keeps the shared trigger's `rounded-md` and 12 px label; the artboard draws an 8 px radius and 13 px text. One element serves Home and every app.
- **The summary's zero claim.** The approvals count carries no read status (`useSharedPendingApprovalsCount` returns the value only), so while the read is in flight, or after it fails, the line says "Nothing is waiting for you today". The action center's "You're all caught up", on `main` before this card, treats the same count as an answer too: it waits for the inbox read's status only. Carrier: objectui#12602, whose section must hide "for a caller who may read none of the three sources" and so needs that status.
- **Tile colour.** The tile keeps the launcher's deterministic gradient per app, which the artboard draws too; it does not read `branding.primaryColor` (the ruling that `AppMark` implements names the bar's pill, the switcher rows and the drawer header). Carrier: none.
- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/makerEmptyState-v1-scope-8329.test.ts` names `home.build.subtitle` in a scope comment; the key is removed here. Comment only, left as it is.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
